column1: # bioThreatFinder marker catalogue - human health pack
# For a large share of the watchlist, the chromosome is NOT the actionable
# signal. B. anthracis is chromosomally near-identical to the B. cereus group;
# what makes it anthrax is pXO1/pXO2. C. botulinum is polyphyletic and the
# actionable signal is the BoNT cluster, which also occurs in C. butyricum.
# E. coli presence is uninformative - only the pathotype matters. Reporting any
# of these from chromosomal breadth alone is not defensible.
# KEYED BY GENE SYMBOL, NOT ACCESSION - on purpose, exactly as watchlist.tsv is
# keyed by name. Accession numbers written from memory are a fabrication risk in
# a file that gates a high-consequence call. scripts/build_marker_db.py resolves
# each row to real sequences via the named query_strategy and records the
# accession, source and retrieval date in markers.manifest.tsv. Provenance is
#   dna       read alignment to the marker nucleotide sequence
#   protein   translated search (MMseqs2/DIAMOND blastx) - catches a divergent
#             or engineered allele that nucleotide alignment would miss
#   hmm       profile search - the most remote-homology-sensitive tier, for
#             marker families where novel variants are expected (BoNT, Stx)
#   Most rows are dna+protein. Nucleotide alone is not sufficient for a tool that
#   required          Must be present to reach confirmed_in_silico.
#   discriminating    Presence separates the target from a named near neighbour.
#   absence_expected  Presence argues AGAINST the target (e.g. a region the
#                     target has deleted, or a neighbour-specific gene).
#   pathotype         Defines the actionable pathotype rather than the species.
#   vaccine_strain    Presence indicates a vaccine/attenuated strain, not wild
# copy_expectation: single | multi   ('multi' markers must never be used alone -
# multi-copy elements are the classic false-positive route, e.g. IS481.)
#---- Bacillus anthracis: chromosome is not enough --------------------------

CURATION NEEDED: B. mallei is a deletion clone of pseudomallei, so it is defined by ABSENCE of regions. Needs curated absent-region coordinates; cannot be done with presence markers.

column13: MULTI-COPY (0-25x). Sensitive, not specific within MTBC.
